scenes.headline: How a critic learns to think before it scores
scenes.sub: TEMPO, the training method inside dots3-note Preview.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Scone! dots3-note Preview is an open model with sixteen billion active parameters. The news is TEMPO, a way to train on tasks that run for hours.

scenes.text: Cut a long task into macro-steps. After each one, the same agent turns critic and reasons about how it is doing, so learning starts mid-task.
scenes.say: The idea: cut a long task into macro-steps. After each one, the same agent turns critic, and reasons about how it's doing. So learning starts mid-task.

left.title: A usual critic
items: Cannot reason, reflect or use tools
left.say: A usual critic, as in PPO, scores a state with one fixed-compute forward pass. It cannot reason, reflect, or use tools.

right.title: TEMPO's critic
items: The agent itself, switched to critic
Spends test-time reasoning on the estimate
Predicts the return still to come
right.say: TEMPO's critic is the agent itself. It spends real inference thinking about the state, then estimates the return still to come.

steps.say: One rollout can run past ten hours, with sparse rewards. So TEMPO cuts it into macro-steps, each several rounds of interaction.
At the end of each macro-step, the same agent switches from actor to critic.
As critic, it reasons about the state it is in, and estimates the return it can still expect.
That estimate updates the policy mid-task, instead of after ten hours. Then the next macro-step begins.

scenes.quote: Even when the agent cannot yet solve a problem, it can act as a critic to distinguish between two superficially similar states
scenes.mark: it can act as a critic
scenes.say: Why it works: evaluation is easier than generation. Two puzzle branches, both sixty-four rounds in, scored the same. Only one had found the real rule. The critic told them apart.

scenes.label: average score over GRPO on ARC-AGI-3, in fewer steps
scenes.say: The reported result on ARC-AGI-3: twenty point six percent above GRPO on average, reaching the same level in fewer steps.

scenes.text: A critic should be allowed to think: when acting takes hours of reasoning, judging does too.
scenes.say: So a critic should be allowed to think. When acting well takes hours of reasoning, judging how it's going takes reasoning too.

recap: Long tasks are cut into macro-steps
The same agent turns critic and reasons
The policy learns mid-task, not after it
scenes.say: To recap: macro-steps, the agent as its own thinking critic, and learning mid-task.
